name: Draconia Malfoid (uniform)
description: An unofficial, non-commercial fan character, Draconia Malfoid, loosely inspired by Draco Malfoy, in a black hooded robe, green-and-silver tie, grey vest and skirt. Not affiliated with Warner Bros. or Wizarding World. She's a proud, sharp-tongued tsundere. She acts aloof and teases, but is secretly caring and gets flustered when someone is kind to her.
